original_test_intent: Verify the complete SMBIOS Type 3 chassis identity, physical inventory and status/security fields against the platform specification and across an approved reboot.
original_method: Collect all Type 3 records and raw provenance on the bound chassis, apply separate invariant and runtime-state expectations, reboot under approval/recovery, then repeat at defined steady-state and compare every named field with preserved logs.
manual_activity: Owner defines exact chassis values and allowed sampling-phase transitions, approves protected evidence and reboot, and provides console/OOB recovery.
required_inputs: Allowed bootup/power/thermal/security values by sampling phase
safety_requirements: Do not suppress decoder errors or bypass target authentication
Capture the complete record even if headings differ
Do not interpret transient state without the approved sampling policy
Stop on unsafe state or boot failure
agent_execution_scope: Capture complete pre-state and relevant BMC/SEL health
engineer_actions: Supply chassis recipe and transition policy

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `dmidecode -t 3` is appropriate, but `grep -iA1 "System Chassis Record"` is too short and may not match the decoder heading; it cannot capture 14 fields or phase semantics, and its SSH handling is unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely capture every complete Type 3 record plus BMC/SEL context before and after an approved reboot at specified sampling points, then compare invariant inventory and permitted status transitions separately.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All 14 source-listed values, correctness, pre/post comparison, reboot persistence and 5/5-minute timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a typed record separating immutable inventory, platform-defined optional values and phase-dependent status fields, correlated with boot ID and BMC sensor/SEL timestamps.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds complete phase-aware evidence instead of treating every string as a timeless invariant.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects inventory drift while avoiding false failures from approved boot-state changes and correlates unsafe thermal/power/security anomalies.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS may expose static design-time status rather than live chassis health; BMC evidence is corroborative and cannot silently replace the Type 3 requirement.

project_override_considerations: The project must declare whether status fields are static design values or expected live snapshots and define acceptable pre/post phases. OEM data cannot be guessed from generic SMBIOS semantics.
expected_evidence: No hardware PASS claim by the agent

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently targets Type 3 chassis data and reboot persistence; `Asset Tage` is an obvious label typo, not a material intent conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The field oracle, state policy, decoder and reboot controls are finite inputs; lack of them delays execution rather than invalidating review.

review_improvement: Prevents a header snippet or unqualified equality check from misjudging phase-dependent chassis status and omitting sensitive inventory fields.
independent_technical_reasoning: Type 3 mixes identity with status-like values. Requiring literal equality without defining sample phase can be wrong, while tolerating any change would erase coverage. A case-specific transition oracle plus full raw evidence resolves that distinction; because reboot and recovery are confirmed external actions, REQUIRES is correct.
